question: Can even immense material wealth justify receiving this kaula teaching?
premises: One may possess enough to fill an ocean with jewels
Such accumulation is contrasted with the teaching
inference: Even immense wealth is not a sufficient basis for receiving the teaching.
uncertainties: The form akretuṃ is nonstandard and interpreted as an infinitive sense.
plain_english: Even one who has an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels.
